svg.title: Connect luteal function with maintenance and withdrawal
svg.desc: A downward chain connects functioning ovarian corpus luteum to progesterone and estrogen support and then to maintenance of secretory uterine endometrium. A separate conditional withdrawal chain shows luteal regression, falling steroid support and functional lining breakdown when early pregnancy does not sustain support. Reduced negative feedback permits signalling changes supporting the next follicular cycle. Progesterone acts on the lining, whereas early hCG helps maintain the ovarian source. The oocyte is not the source of menstrual tissue.

text.tspan: Connect luteal function with maintenance and withdrawal
Follow ovarian support to its uterine target; these are different tissues.
Luteal regression → steroid support falls → functional lining breaks down and sheds.
Reduced negative feedback also permits changes supporting the next follicular cycle.
Progesterone supports the lining; early hCG helps maintain its ovarian source.
